title: Basic English — Course 1, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 03

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. Listen to Noah. What time does the bus usually arrive?
tasks.audioText: Hi, I'm Noah. I leave home at quarter past seven and walk to the bus stop. The bus usually arrives at half past seven. My first lesson begins at half past eight. I must bring my student ID card today because we are visiting the college library. The library office is on the ground floor, opposite the reception desk.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Why does Noah need his student ID card today?
tasks.audioText: Hi, I'm Noah. I leave home at quarter past seven and walk to the bus stop. The bus usually arrives at half past seven. My first lesson begins at half past eight. I must bring my student ID card today because we are visiting the college library. The library office is on the ground floor, opposite the reception desk.
options: He is visiting the college library
He is joining a sports club

tasks.prompt: Reading 1. Read the text. Aisha wants to learn English words more effectively. She makes small cards: the English word is on one side and its meaning is on the other. She looks at five cards on the way to college and checks them again before dinner. When she learns a new word, she writes a sentence about college life. At the end of the week, she asks a friend to test her. What does Aisha write when she learns a new word?
options: A long story about a holiday

tasks.prompt: Reading 2. When does Aisha ask a friend to test her?
options: At the end of the week

tasks.prompt: Choose the correct article: 'He is ___ student at our college.'

options: There is three books on the desk.
Do he live near the college?
There are two windows in the classroom.
My sister studies English every day.

tasks.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word: 'You can ___ a book from the college library and return it later.'
You need to use your classmate's pen. What is the most polite request?
options: Can I borrow your pen, please?

tasks.prompt: Put the steps of borrowing a library book in the correct order.
options: Take the book to the library desk
Choose a book from the shelf
Receive the book and the return date
correctOrder: Choose a book from the shelf
Take the book to the library desk
Receive the book and the return date

tasks.prompt: Write 60–80 words about how you learn new English words. Describe two methods you use or would like to try, when you practise and why English is useful for your studies.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: two vocabulary-learning methods and when the learner practises are described (0–2); the usefulness of English for the learner's studies is explained with a relevant reason or example (0–2); basic grammar and sentence links are understandable (0–2); learning-strategy vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are appropriate (0–2).
